scripts.build: bun run build:client && bun run build:server
scripts.build:client: rm -rf public/chunks && bun build src/client/main.ts --target browser --minify --splitting --outdir public --entry-naming app.js --chunk-naming chunks/[name]-[hash].js
scripts.dev: bun run build:client && bun run --hot src/server.ts
scripts.start: bun run build:client && bun run src/server.ts
